description: A rust-red brown knee-length wool-looking tunic with a short open neck and narrow muted gold woven-looking trim around the neckline, cuffs and hem. A cream underlayer shows at the collar and wrists. A simple broad dark brown leather-looking belt with a rectangular metal buckle secures the waist and has a long loose end. Brown textured trousers and tall dark brown soft boots complete the outfit. The fabrics look matte and durable; exact fibres cannot be confirmed. No headgear, weapons or armor are present.
